newsitem.title: UK: UK in "controllable boom" - Conservative source.
newsitem.headline: UK in "controllable boom" - Conservative source.

text.p: Britain's economy is experiencing a controllable boom but there will be no bust to follow, a senior member of the ruling Conservative Party said on Wednesday.
Asked whether he would describe Britian's economy as in a boom, the source told reporters: "A boom, but a controllable boom -- a boom that is not going to turn into bust."

The senior Conservative said the conditions were ripe in Britain to create flourishing prosperity that would last. Growth was strong, consumer confidence was high, inflation was low and unemployment was falling.
"It is a healthy boom, a sustainable boom," he said.
The senior source said he expected that Britain's future economic cycles would be marked by the sort of relatively modest fluctuations characteristic of other healthy economies.
"No return to boom and bust, no rollercoaster of the kind the British economy has suffered from in the past," the Conservative said.
